latin: Secundum precedentem conclusionem ex Procli mente potest exponi unum ex dictis Zoroastris secundum quod apud Graecos legitur, quanquam apud Chaldeos aliter et legitur et exponitur.
translation: In accordance with the preceding conclusion, one of the sayings of Zoroaster, as it is read among the Greeks, can be expounded from the mind of Proclus, although among the Chaldeans it is both read and expounded differently.
